featured_reviews.name: Parthiv
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased an expensive pair of glasses from Lenskart, and I am extremely disappointed with the build quality. In the showroom, the frame felt sturdy, stiff, and high-quality. However, almost immediately after purchasing them, the frames became incredibly loose.
It feels like the "premium" feel was just a storefront illusion. For the price I paid, I expected the hinges and frame tension to last more than a few days. Now, they won't even stay on my face properly. Save your money and go somewhere that offers actual durability, not just a flashy display.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review regarding my recent experience at the Lenskart store in Nalasopara East (near station).
I purchased my glasses from Lenskart (Order #131964706). Today morning, while driving, one of the frame screws came out. Since my power is quite high, it is extremely difficult for me to manage without glasses even for a single day.
I visited the store requesting a quick fix for the screw. However, I was told that it would take one full day to repair, even though it was just a minor issue.
Later, I went to a local optical shop, and they fixed it in less than two minutes.
As a customer, I expect better and quicker after-sales support from a reputed brand like Lenskart. For such a small repair, immediate assistance should be provided, especially when the customer is highly dependent on the product.
I hope the management looks into improving customer service at this store.

– You can order online or visit physical stores. Some stores offer professional eye tests and try-ons.  
Trustpilot
⚠️ Common Complaints
1. Mixed product quality
– Many customers report lenses or frames wearing quickly or not meeting expectations, especially at higher price tiers.  
Trustpilot
2. Customer service issues
– Reviews often mention slow delivery, difficulty with returns/exchanges, unresponsive support, and misleading offers or upsells.  
Sitejabber
3. In-store service varies
– Some outlets have helpful staff, but others get feedback for rude behaviour or incorrect eye tests.  
Trustpilot
🧠 Bottom Line
Lenskart can be a good choice if you want affordable eyewear with a large selection and don’t mind checking product quality thoroughly. However, expect varied experiences across locations and be cautious with offers and customer support expectations.
